_comment: QUARRY sequential-survey object registry -- 8 objects, 1:1 with 8 waypoints (tags 0-7, no separate reference tags -- room frame anchored to the robot's start position per the venue-setup decision). number = sequential visit order. target_name must match what's passed to register_target() in register_mission_objects.py. expected_waypoint must be one of real_feed.WAYPOINTS[*]['id']. twin_semantic_label is the DECOY the Cyberwave twin displays at that waypoint -- deliberately mismatched from the real object's true shape/color, per the project's core mechanic: voters cross-check the real feed against the twin view and dispute the twin's false claim. description is the real object's actual shape/color, for humans, not consumed by matching logic.
